title: Lazy-load the tutor-grants roster in ManageGrantsScreen and Settings' embedded pending-invites section

evidence.quote:
for (final grant in activeGrants)
                    _GrantRow(grant: grant, canResign: true),

for (final grant in pendingGrants) ...[
          _TutorGrantTile(grant: grant, isPending: true),

why: Both screens map `incomingTutorGrantsProvider`/`pendingTutorInvitesProvider` (a tutor's full roster of children/parents who granted them access) into rows via a `for` loop feeding a non-lazy ListView/Column, in two independent places, and no cap on roster size exists anywhere in the codebase (grepped for maxTutor/tutorLimit/kMaxTutors and product-rules.md — none found). A dedicated tutor (e.g. a rebbi/melamed tracking many talmidim across seasons — the tutoring feature's own stated use case) accumulates one grant per student relationship over time with no visible archiving path; both the dedicated Manage Grants hub and the every-visit Settings screen's embedded pending-invites card rebuild every row on every open/rebuild. This is lower-urgency than the curriculum-hierarchy findings above (realistic roster sizes are more plausibly in the tens than the hundreds), but it is a genuine, duplicated PF-2 pattern on two commonly-visited screens — Settings in particular re-renders the full roster inline on its own top-level ListView every time any grant's state changes.
recommendation: Swap the `for`-loop expansion in ManageGrantsScreen (which already scrolls independently) for ListView.builder/ListView.separated. For Settings' embedded _PendingInvitesSection (which must stay non-scrolling inside the outer settings ListView), cap the inline preview (e.g. first 3-5 grants + a 'View all' link into Manage Grants) instead of rendering the full roster inline.
acceptance_criteria: Rule-0: PF-2 checker flags `for (final ... in ...)`/`.map(...)` expansions feeding ListView(/Column( children under lib/features/** where the source is a ref.watch'd stream/future provider rather than a literal bounded enum.

Regression test: seed 50 tutor grants in the fixture repo; pump ManageGrantsScreen and SettingsScreen and assert both build within a bounded frame budget, and (post-fix) that off-screen _GrantRow/_TutorGrantTile widgets are not realized via find.byType counts.

corrections: A third analogous site exists (manage_tutors_screen.dart:261-278, parent-side per-child tutor list) not counted in 'sites: 2' — an undercount, not an overclaim, so it doesn't weaken the finding.
